pages.text: Hold the hot ingot and right-click the anvil. A bar appears, with a marker sweeping back and forth. Each fresh right-click is one strike: aim for the $(2)green$() sweet spot, or better, its $(6)gold$() middle.$(br2)Three strikes shape an ingot (more for higher stars). Gold strikes count twice and are always safe.
pages.title: The Bar

pages.text: A strike outside the green might crack the ingot: 30% for the first miss in a bar, 45% for the second, and so on. Cracked metal leaves iron nuggets. Your Forging skill lowers the odds.$(br2)The result is a $(item)Struck Ingot$(), still hot. Quench it before it cools.
pages.title: Misses
